entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:1
segments: ¶When a man hath taken a wife, and married her, and it come to pass that she find no favour in his eyes, because he hath found some uncleanness in her: then let him write her a bill of divorcement, and give [it] in her hand, and send her out of his house. {some...: Heb. matter of nakedness} {divorcement: Heb. cutting off}

in her: then let him write

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:2
segments: And when she is departed out of his house, she may go and be another man's [wife].

words.text: And when she is departed out

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:3
segments: And [if] the latter husband hate her, and write her a bill of divorcement, and giveth [it] in her hand, and sendeth her out of his house; or if the latter husband die, which took her [to be] his wife;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:4
segments: Her former husband, which sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife, after that she is defiled; for that [is] abomination before the LORD: and thou shalt not cause the land to sin, which the LORD thy God giveth thee [for] an inheritance.

words.text: : and thou shalt not cause the land

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:5
segments: ¶When a man hath taken a new wife, he shall not go out to war, neither shall he be charged with any business: [but] he shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer up his wife which he hath taken. {neither...: Heb. not any thing shall pass upon him}

words.text: . {neither...: Heb. not any thing shall pass upon him}

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:6
segments: No man shall take the nether or the upper millstone to pledge: for he taketh [a man's] life to pledge.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:7
segments: If a man be found stealing any of his brethren of the children of Israel, and maketh merchandise of him, or selleth him; then that thief shall die; and thou shalt put evil away from among you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:8
segments: Take heed in the plague of leprosy, that thou observe diligently, and do according to all that the priests the Levites shall teach you: as I commanded them, [so] ye shall observe to do.

words.text: according to all that the priests

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:9
segments: Remember what the LORD thy God did unto Miriam by the way, after that ye were come forth out of Egypt.

words.text: , after that ye were come forth

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:10
segments: When thou dost lend thy brother any thing, thou shalt not go into his house to fetch his pledge. {lend...: Heb. lend the loan of any thing to, etc}

words.text: . {lend...: Heb. lend the loan of any thing to, etc}

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:11
segments: Thou shalt stand abroad, and the man to whom thou dost lend shall bring out the pledge abroad unto thee.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:12
segments: And if the man [be] poor, thou shalt not sleep with his pledge:

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:13
segments: In any case thou shalt deliver him the pledge again when the sun goeth down, that he may sleep in his own raiment, and bless thee: and it shall be righteousness unto thee before the LORD thy God.

words.text: thee: and it shall be righteousness

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:14
segments: ¶Thou shalt not oppress an hired servant [that is] poor and needy, [whether he be] of thy brethren, or of thy strangers that [are] in thy land within thy gates:

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:15
segments: At his day thou shalt give [him] his hire, neither shall the sun go down upon it; for he [is] poor, and setteth his heart upon it: lest he cry against thee unto the LORD, and it be sin unto thee. {setteth...: Heb. lifteth his soul unto it}

words.text: unto thee. {setteth...: Heb. lifteth his soul unto it}

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:16
segments: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers: every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

words.text: shall not be put to death

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:17
segments: Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of the stranger, [nor] of the fatherless; nor take a widow's raiment to pledge:

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:18
segments: But thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt, and the LORD thy God redeemed thee thence: therefore I command thee to do this thing.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:19
segments: When thou cuttest down thine harvest in thy field, and hast forgot a sheaf in the field, thou shalt not go again to fetch it: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow: that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hands.

words.text: it: it shall be for the stranger

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:20
segments: When thou beatest thine olive tree, thou shalt not go over the boughs again: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow. {go...: Heb. bough it after thee}

words.text: , thou shalt not go over the boughs
: it shall be for the stranger

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:21
segments: When thou gatherest the grapes of thy vineyard, thou shalt not glean [it] afterward: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow. {afterward: Heb. after thee}

words.text: : it shall be for the stranger

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:22
segments: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt: therefore I command thee to do this thing.
